description: Track a competitor. Looks the handle up through Meta and starts tracking it. The account must be a public Instagram business or creator account; personal and private accounts cannot be read by anyone through the API (422 invalid_param). At the plan cap this is 403 plan_limit_reached, and an account you already track is 409 conflict. The first snapshot is taken immediately.

username.description: Instagram handle, with or without the leading @. Must be a public business or creator account.
